nodes.label: Language Detection Prompt
nodes.rationale: LLM prompt template for detecting the language of input text, returning ISO 639-1 language code.

nodes.label: Translation Prompt
nodes.rationale: LLM prompt template for line-by-line translation with context, preserving proper nouns and maintaining line count.

nodes.label: Abbreviation Prompt
nodes.rationale: LLM prompt template for expanding abbreviations line by line based on given context, preserving capitalization.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Prompt
nodes.rationale: LLM prompt template for reconciling input values against a controlled list. Returns strict JSON with up to 5 candidate matches per input, scores in [0,1] rounded to two decimals, and 2-4 reason bullets per candidate.
